items.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: two other guys started, we started the same time, Red Mitchell and Kenny O’Brien. We started with this guy in 1946.

ctx.x: Because of Milt Hinton? © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

Yeah. I’ll tell you what happened. I was always watching every drummer. I knew that’s what I went to see. And I saw Cab Calloway was going to be at a theater and I’d never seen Cozy Cole, because I tried to study with him but he was very busy, but I’d never seen him play, and I knew he was working with Cab so I said I’m going to go see Cozy Cole after I take my lesson. And I went to the theater, and a new drummer had just joined the band, and I didn’t catch his name, and he took a drum solo and it was…
It didn’t take you too long before you started playing out.
